Broad disorder of lymphoid immune tissues; blood, marrow or any particular anatomical organ is not consistently affected across the group.
Recurrent immune-mediated inflammation of the optic nerve head causes cumulative visual loss; optic nerve involvement belongs to ocular.
Benign ovarian epithelial neoplasm; reproductive tissue has no axis, and ovarian origin does not imply endocrine dysfunction.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy with established foot deformities: pes cavus 6/6 and hammertoes 4/4. Reported diabetes is a separate disease.
Hepatic heme-synthesis disorder. Neurovisceral attacks do not establish persistent neurologic damage in at least 30%; erythrocyte enzyme activity is preserved.
Isolated inherited right ventricular cardiomyopathy with ventricular arrhythmias; no syndromic skin or skeletal muscle involvement is established.
Skeletal dysplasia with cutis laxa 5/5 and global developmental delay 4/5. Oligodontia in 1/2 is insufficient to establish group prevalence; reflux is separate.
Severe inherited sideroblastic anemia. Hepatic iron and hypogonadism occur in 3/3, but intrinsic injury cannot be distinguished from transfusional iron overload.
Adenocarcinoma originates in gallbladder or extrahepatic bile-duct epithelium; both belong to hepatic.
Prostate neoplasm is a reproductive-organ disease; urinary obstruction or metastatic damage is not inherent across this umbrella.
Erosive lichen planus involving gingiva and vulvovaginal mucocutaneous tissue; gingivitis is obligatory and chronic skin erosions are frequent.
Extragonadal germ-cell tumor without a specified covered organ of origin; mediastinal and retroperitoneal locations alone do not establish lung or kidney disease.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and congenital cardiac defects define the syndrome. External ear and facial dysmorphism do not establish functional organ damage.
Bone fragility, developmental impairment and hearing loss define syndrome; severe myopia 3/4. Dental defects 5/5, anemia 4/4 and conduction defects 4/6 omitted by cap.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation directly damages the esophagus; childhood onset adds no other organ.
Inherited myocardial disease with right ventricular fibrofatty replacement and ventricular arrhythmias; isolated form has no defining extracardiac damage.
Marrow failure and diagnostic nail/skin changes and oral leukoplakia; pulmonary fibrosis 3/6. Hepatic fibrosis 2/6 and osteoporosis 3/6 omitted by cap.
Broad Xp deletion group with neurodevelopmental disease recurring across listed subtypes; ocular, muscle, skin and endocrine involvement depends on the deleted interval.
Retinal disorder defined by bilateral retinal flecks despite preserved vision and electrophysiology; no extraocular disease is established.
Psychiatric behavioral-disorder umbrella; structural neurologic disease or lasting damage to another axis is not inherent across the group.
Pregnancy-associated glucose intolerance is a metabolic disorder; later diabetes and obstetric complications do not establish additional organ damage.
Arteriovenous malformation of the maxillary jaw involves abnormal vessels and their bony site; listed oral, ocular and ear symptoms do not establish common organ damage.
Carcinoma originates in a pleomorphic adenoma of the lacrimal gland, which belongs to the ocular axis.
Dermal hypoplasia and limb malformations define syndrome; ocular malformations and dental hypoplasia each affect ≥30%. Frequent intellectual disability omitted by cap.
